title: Red Team / Blue Team: Cloud-Native Security Mastery
prereqs: Comfort reading and writing YAML, Bash, Go
description: Full kill chain, full defense. Attack a Kubernetes cluster using the MITRE ATT&CK framework — IMDS credential theft, lateral movement, container escape, data exfiltration — then flip to blue team: Falco runtime detection, SPIFFE/SPIRE zero trust, Vault dynamic secrets, OPA/Kyverno policy, CIS hardening, and incident response. Ends with a Red Team Lab: a deliberately misconfigured cluster you attack end-to-end then harden from scratch.
